hook.name: HookeMemeHook
hook.description: Meme launchpad hook that pairs new tokens against hXMAX on a concentrated bonding curve, charges 1% hXMAX fees on all swaps via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapReturnsDelta, locks external liquidity until the curve is bought out, then graduates the position into a permanently burned Uniswap v4 LP. Post-graduation buys are handled in the same swap via a nested pool swap.
